what: A message sent while the previous turn is still running (queued). The two payloads are what the UserPromptSubmit hook received for the running turn and for the queued message; the transcript excerpt is the maintainer's queued approval of 2026-11-01 00:03:27Z (DRIFT-006): its queue-operation enqueue and dequeue lines and its user entry.
method: Payloads: a headless probe (claude -p with stream-json input, --setting-sources local) in a scratch git folder outside any repository, the second message written 8 seconds into a 20-second first turn; a capture hook copied raw stdin bytes. Excerpt: copied from this repository's development session transcript.
redaction: The user name in every profile path is replaced with probe-user.
finding: The queued message reached the hook with the RUNNING turn's prompt_id (66274807-...), the same as the first message, and different text. In the TUI the queued entry is stored with promptSource queued, origin kind human and its own promptId. A key built from prompt_id alone makes the queued approval the previous turn, already recorded: the router dropped both queued approvals without a reservation or a report (DRIFT-006, DRIFT-012).
